s.how: Grill 8 frankfurts. Put in 8 hot dog buns with diced raw onion, 60g crispy fried onions, sweet mustard and 100g remoulade or tartare. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Spread 16 rye crispbreads with 150g crème fraîche. Top with 250g flaked smoked trout, thin pickled cucumber and dill. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Heat the oven to 160C. Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, thyme and 4 crushed garlic cloves and roast covered for 3 hours, uncovering for the last 30 minutes. Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender and peel. Melt 80g sugar in a pan until golden, add 40g butter and the potatoes and toss 5 minutes until glazed. Make gravy from the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour, 150ml red wine and 300ml stock. Serve with buttered peas.

w.note: the little elf houses Sigrit leaves gifts at
w.how: Mix 80g rolled oats, 60g plain flour, 50g brown sugar and 60g melted butter, spread on a tray and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until golden. Cool and crumble. Beat 400g skyr or thick Greek yoghurt with 150g cream cheese and 3 tbsp honey until smooth. Simmer 250g blueberries with 2 tbsp sugar and lemon juice for 5 minutes. Layer crumble, skyr and compote in 4 glasses and chill 1 hour.

d.how: Pour 20ml elderflower cordial into each of 4 flutes and top with chilled sparkling wine. Elderflower and soda water for the kids. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
